event_date_basis: Three independent first-party confirmations, all re-read on 2026-09-18: (1) both the model post and the developer post carry <meta property="article:published_time" content="2026-09-15">, <meta name="published_time" content="2026-09-15T17:00:00+00:00"> and a visible byline 'Sep 15, 2026'; (2) the two posts share the same official RSS pubDate 'Tue, 15 Sep 2026 17:00:00 +0000' (per the batch research record; not independently re-polled today since blog.google/rss/ is not one of this article's four sources); (3) the DeepMind model card is stamped 'Published 15 September 2026', confirmed again today. Google's own phrase for both models is 'rolling out starting today', so 2026-09-15 is also the start of availability. Two other stamps are deliberately NOT used as event-date evidence: the Gemini API pricing page footer reads 'Last updated 2026-09-16 UTC' on today's fetch, and the identical string appears on unrelated Gemini API docs pages, so it is a site-wide build stamp; and the model post's own body opens with an italic line 'Updated September 17, 2026', which is a revision stamp on the source document, not the event. slug date 20260915 and news_date 2026-09-15 are both correct.

sourcing_notes: This is a re-verification of an already-researched and independently fact-checked slug (docs/news-2026-batch-4/research/ai-news-gemini-38-live-20260915.json, factcheck/ai-news-gemini-38-live-20260915.json: verdict needs_fixes, 47/48 facts confirmed, 3 refuted, 3 unsupported-as-framed). This record applies every must_fix and must_add from docs/news-2026-batch-4/corrections-ai.md and adds a fresh, independent same-day refetch rather than trusting the two-day-old snapshot. 2026-09-18, curl -sL -A "Mokaair-editorial" against all four sources (no email, name or personal data in any request): model post HTTP 200, 429,811 bytes; developer post HTTP 200, 391,560 bytes; model card HTTP 200, 148,728 bytes; pricing page HTTP 200, 243,407 bytes. All four are the real article body (not a challenge page, redirect shell or soft-404); none required a redirect. Spot-checked and reproduced today, verbatim, among others: 'article:published_time' 2026-09-15 and 'Sep 15, 2026' on both posts; 'rolling out starting today' (both models); '97 supported languages' (model post) vs '97+ languages' (developer post); the full availability blocks for both models including the Docs-vs-Gmail/Keep subscription split; the model card's channel lists for both models, which both name Gemini App and Google Cloud / Vertex AI; 'Published 15 September 2026'; 'knowledge cutoff date is January 2025'; '128K' context and the benchmark figures 82.6 / 68.6% / 35.1% / 97.7%; pricing figures $0.75, $4.50, $3, $12 per 1M tokens and the $0.005/$0.018 per-minute estimate with its footnote; the grounding terms '5,000 free search requests per month ... then $14 per 1,000 requests'; a full-text scan for region/country/market/worldwide/globally/United States across all three Google pages returned zero region statements (the one 'market' hit is inside 'marketing toolkits', a video caption, not a region claim). Two of the batch research record's four sources were kept as-is because today's refetch reproduced them cleanly; no source was swapped. Not used as sources today, and not needed for anything this article states: the evaluation PDF (https://storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-media/gemini/gemini_3-8_live_model_evaluation.pdf), the Live API thinking guide, the Gemini 3.5 Transcribe launch post and blog.google/rss/ -- all four are outside the 4-source cap this slug already uses cleanly, so nothing that depends only on them (the gemini-3.8-live-preview vs gemini-3.8-live id split, the Sierra tau-cubed-Bench alternate name, thinking_level API mechanics, the exact 2026-08-26 publish date for 3.5 Transcribe) is written into the article; see corrections_applied and unverified_or_excluded.

verified_facts.fact: Both blog.google posts were published/byline-dated 2026-09-15: meta article:published_time=2026-09-15 and a visible byline reading 'Sep 15, 2026' on both the model post and the developer post.

Google positions the two models differently in the same sentence pair: Gemini 3.8 Live is built for scale and cost efficiency; Extended Thinking is built for high-complexity tasks with more intelligence and multi-step reasoning.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Built for scale and cost efficiency, combining conversational intelligence with fluid dialogue and visual grounding.

verified_facts.fact: The page's visible standfirst (distinct from the meta description) reads that the two models are Google's most advanced live dialogue models yet, with major upgrades in intelligence and parallel reasoning.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Major upgrades in intelligence and parallel reasoning make them more intuitive to collaborate with and use to execute complex tasks using your voice.

verified_facts.fact: Gemini 3.8 Live automatically detects and transitions between 97 supported languages mid-conversation, per the model post.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: It automatically detects and transitions between 97 supported languages mid-conversation.

verified_facts.fact: The developer post's multilingual-support bullet gives a different figure, 97+ languages, with a claim of accent consistency.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: 97+ languages

verified_facts.fact: 3.8 Live is rolling out starting today with three bullets: 'For developers': in the Gemini API and Google AI Studio; 'For enterprises': in private preview in Gemini Enterprise and coming soon to Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience; 'For everyone': In Search Live. The list names no other consumer surface for 3.8 Live, which is not the same as Google saying there is none -- the model card lists more (fact 9).
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: 3.8 Live is rolling out starting today

verified_facts.fact: 3.8 Live Extended Thinking's consumer line is wider: Gemini Live for everyone, plus Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in Workspace Docs, plus all Google AI subscribers in Gmail and Keep -- a narrower gate on Docs than on Gmail/Keep.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in Workspace in Docs, and all Google AI subscribers in Gmail and Keep

verified_facts.fact: Three media-carousel captions on the model post name consumer surfaces: Extended Thinking in Workspace as 'Docs Live, Gmail Live, and Keep Live'; 3.8 Live 'right inside Search Live'; and, third, Extended Thinking 'in the Gemini app' ('Manage your day with Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking in the Gemini app'). The third caption matters: the blog post itself, not only the model card, puts Extended Thinking in the Gemini app, so the two documents do not disagree on that point.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: right inside Search Live

verified_facts.fact: Beyond the captions, the model post's running text places the models in the Gemini app twice: the second body paragraph ('across the Gemini app, Google Workspace, and Search') and the section heading over the carousel ('Across Google Workspace, Search, and the Gemini app, our Live models deliver more intuitive, collaborative experiences'). Neither sentence separates the two models. NOTE: the batch fact-check of 2026-09-16 recorded that heading without 'and the Gemini app', and the body now opens with an italic 'Updated September 17, 2026', so this page has been revised since that reading; the article therefore describes the availability list and the captions separately instead of treating the post as one flat statement.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Across Google Workspace, Search, and the Gemini app, our Live models deliver more intuitive, collaborative experiences

verified_facts.fact: The DeepMind model card's Distribution section lists channels as bullet links under one sentence per model. For Gemini 3.8 Live the bullets are Gemini API, Gemini App, Google AI Studio, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, Google Search Live. Second-round correction to how this must be framed: it is NOT true that 'only the model card puts 3.8 Live in the Gemini App'. The model post's own section heading reads 'Across Google Workspace, Search, and the Gemini app, our Live models deliver...' and its second body paragraph reads 'They also make speaking with Gemini across the Gemini app, Google Workspace, and Search more fluid' -- both sentences cover the pair, 3.8 Live included, without separating them. What is true, and all the article may write, is the scoped form: the model post's availability list does not put Gemini App under 3.8 Live's 'For everyone' bullet. Vertex AI is the one genuinely single-sourced item: 'Vertex AI' appears zero times in the readable text of both blog posts and zero times anywhere in the developer post's HTML; the model post's HTML contains the string twice, both times inside one href (https://console.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/studio/multimodal-live, the link behind the words 'Gemini Enterprise'), which is a URL, not a channel the post names. Conversely the model card's Distribution lists omit Gemini Enterprise, which the model post's availability list does name, so neither list contains the other.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Gemini 3.8 Live is distributed in the following channels; respective documentation shared in line:

verified_facts.fact: The model card's channel list for Extended Thinking, confirmed today, names Gemini App, Gemini API, Google AI Studio, Google Cloud / Vertex AI and Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, and Keep).
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking is distributed in the following channels

verified_facts.fact: Scoped negative, method stated: on 2026-09-18 a word-boundary scan of the rendered text of all three Google pages for region / country / countries / market / worldwide / globally / United States / Taiwan returned zero hits on every term except 'global', whose four hits on the blog pages are the site's own chrome ('Global network' in the nav, 'Global (English)' in the locale picker) plus the developer post's 'Reach global audiences'. No availability sentence on any of the three pages names a country, region or market. This is 'these pages do not say', not 'Google says there is no restriction'. Note also that the blog's locale picker prints about thirty country names including 台灣 (中文); those are site navigation, not availability statements, so 'no country name appears on the page' would be false and must not be written.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Watch Gemini 3.8 Live build complete business plans and custom marketing toolkits on the fly through natural speech.

verified_facts.fact: Developer pricing headline, from the developer post: 'Competitively priced at $0.005/min for audio input and $0.018/min[1] for audio output, they allow developers to scale voice applications with industry-leading performance.' The superscript 1 resolves to the footnote quoted here. The two figures are Google's arithmetic, not a per-minute rate card; 'Competitively priced' and 'industry-leading performance' are vendor rhetoric and must not be repeated as fact, which is why this entry is flagged as a vendor claim even though the dollar figures are printed values.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Estimate based on $3/1M tokens for input and $12/1M tokens for output

verified_facts.fact: The pricing page prints the same per-minute figures next to the per-token ones inside the 3.8 Live block, under the column header 'Paid Tier, per 1M tokens in USD': input '$0.75 (text)', '$3.00 or $0.005/min (audio)', '$1.00 or $0.002/min (image/video)'; output (including thinking tokens) '$4.50 (text)', '$12.00 or $0.018/min (audio)'. Unlike the Gemini 3.5 Live Translate and 3.5 Transcribe blocks further down the same page, this block carries no asterisk explaining the per-minute conversion; only the developer post's footnote calls it an estimate.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: $3.00 or $0.005/min (audio)

verified_facts.fact: The developer post frames Extended Thinking's mechanism as 'configurable thinking' for background multi-step reasoning, and calls the pair a more streamlined alternative to cascaded architectures.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: a more streamlined alternative to cascaded architectures.

verified_facts.fact: The developer post's alphanumeric-precision bullet: models can accurately parse confirmation codes, claim numbers and technical data.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Accurately parse confirmation codes, claim numbers, and technical data

verified_facts.fact: Official model identifiers on the pricing page: gemini-3.8-live and gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking, grouped in one pricing block together with the older gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking

verified_facts.fact: Paid-tier price per 1M tokens: input $0.75 (text); output (including thinking tokens) $4.50 (text).
A free tier exists (input and output both 'Free of charge'); the same table marks free-tier traffic 'Used to improve our products: Yes' versus 'No' for the paid tier.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview

verified_facts.fact: Grounding with Google Search: 5,000 free search requests per month shared across all Gemini 3.x models, then $14 per 1,000 requests.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: 5,000 free search requests per month (shared across all Gemini 3.x models), then $14 per 1,000 requests.

verified_facts.fact: Model card: published 15 September 2026, titled 'Gemini 3.8 Audio (Live, Live Extended Thinking)', both models based on Gemini 3 Pro.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Published 15 September 2026

verified_facts.fact: Model card: inputs are audio, images, video and text with a context window 'of up to 128K'; outputs are 'Audio and text, with 64K token output' -- the 'up to' hedge is printed on the context-window side only, so the output figure must not be written as a ceiling.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: token context window of up to 128K

verified_facts.fact: Model card: the knowledge cutoff date is January 2025, independent of live Search grounding.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: knowledge cutoff date is January 2025

verified_facts.fact: Model card frontier-safety section: assessments were run on Gemini 3.7 Flash (not on these two models), found no Tracked or Critical Capability Levels, and Google infers 3.8 Live / Extended Thinking are 'not likely' to reach any because they show no meaningful new capability or material performance increase over 3.7 Flash.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: not likely to reach any T/CCLs

verified_facts.fact: Model card known limitations: possible hallucinations common to foundation models, ongoing work on jailbreak resistance, and occasional slowness or timeout.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: There may also be occasional slowness or timeout issues.

verified_facts.fact: Benchmark claims, all Google's own: '#1 overall spot on Artificial Analysis' Speech to Speech Quality Index (82.6)'; 'leads in agentic task completion with 68.6% on τ-Voice and 35.1% on Sierra's τ-Voice-banking benchmark'; '97.7% on Big Bench Audio, while maintaining a highly competitive price point compared to other frontier models'; Gemini 3.8 Live 'second place in the Speech Agent Arena'.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: 97.7% on Big Bench Audio, while maintaining a highly competitive price point compared to other frontier models.

verified_facts.fact: Google names Salesforce, Genspark and Lumeris as partners who are 'excited about' the models' latency, fluidity and tool-calling; no deployment metric or customer quote is given.
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: partnering with companies like Salesforce, Genspark, and Lumeris who are excited about 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, highlighting its impressive latency, fluidity, and tool-calling capabilities.

not_said: No availability sentence on any of the four pages read names a country, region or market; the only launch-day statement is 'rolling out starting today'. (The blog's locale picker does print country names, including 台灣 (中文) -- that is site chrome, not an availability statement, so the negative must be written as 'no availability statement names a region', never as 'no country name appears'.) Second-round addition: the fourth source, the pricing page, was scanned too and also names none -- but it is not silent on the subject, because it prints 'Google AI Studio usage is free of charge in all available regions. See Billing FAQs for details.' and carries a nav link labelled 'Available regions' (the linked page is not one of this article's sources). So the callout's negative is written as 'names no country, region or market when describing availability', with that pricing-page phrase spelled out, never as 'says nothing about regions'. The article must not imply a Taiwan Google account can already use either model.

No interface-language scope for the consumer surfaces (Search Live, Gemini Live, Docs/Gmail/Keep) is given; the 97 / 97+ figures describe what the model can hear and speak inside a session, not which languages the surrounding app is localized into.
No date is given for any 'coming soon' item (Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience for both models; Google Workspace business customers for Extended Thinking only).
No consumer price, quota, session cap or fair-use limit is published for Search Live, Gemini Live, Docs, Gmail or Keep; only the Gemini API's per-token developer prices are stated.
No completion date for the rollout, and no way for a user to tell which model they are talking to on a given surface.
No eligibility criteria, application route or waitlist size is given for the Gemini Enterprise private preview.
No enumeration of the 97 (or 97+) supported languages is published on any of the three pages.
No millisecond latency figure is published; both posts use qualitative language ('near real-time', 'low-latency', 'impressive latency').

No statement on whether audio processed on the consumer surfaces (Search Live, Gemini Live, Workspace) is retained or used for training; the pricing page's 'Used to improve our products: Yes/No' split covers only the Gemini API's free and paid tiers.
No statement that Gemini 3.8 Live deprecates or replaces gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview, which is still listed on the same pricing page.

editorial_brief: 讀者是台灣的一般 Google 使用者，不是開發者或企業採購。全文只回答一個問題：Google 同一天發表的兩款語音模型，分別要透過哪一道門、要什麼身分才進得去，以及哪些條件官方還沒講。骨架：一、發表了什麼與兩種定位；二、開發者／企業／一般使用者／Workspace 訂閱者四種身分各自的通路，結尾放表；三、「即日起推出」為何不等於「現在就能用」，核心是官方未說明開放地區，結尾放圖；四、費用與資料（同一張價目表、免費層級、grounding 費用、128K/64K 與知識截止日）；五、Google 沒講的部分與一個編輯設計的行程情境。三個一定要交代清楚的緊張點：(1) 部落格消費端分工（3.8 Live 只到 Search Live、Extended Thinking 才到 Gemini Live）跟模型卡的通路清單（兩款都列 Gemini App 與 Vertex AI）對不上，兩者並陳，不擅自判定；(2) 97／97+ 兩個語言數字都是 Google 自己給的，不合併成一個；(3) 「即日起推出」只是開始，企業端是私人預覽、消費端有訂閱門檻、地區完全沒講。刻意不談：任何跟 OpenAI GPT-Live 或其他廠商的比較（Google 未做這個比較）、排行榜之外的自行評測、Gemini Live 既有生產力功能的教學（ai-news-gemini-live-20260826 已經寫過）、3.8 Flash 文字模型的成本論證（ai-news-gemini-38-flash-20260902 已經寫過）。
must_not_write: 不寫或暗示台灣（或任何具名國家）的 Google 帳號現在就能用到這兩款模型；三份文件都沒有地區陳述，一律寫「官方未說明開放地區」。
不寫「我們試用」或任何實測觀感；本站沒有實測，所有能力描述都是「Google 表示」。
不把 82.6、68.6%、35.1%、97.7%、第一、第二名這些排行榜數字寫成本站驗證過的事實，一律歸因給 Google 當天的公告，並註明是快照。
不引用 blog.google 頁首「AI 生成摘要」區塊的任何句子；那個區塊有免責聲明，且與正文的可用性清單互相矛盾。
不把 Google AI Pro／Ultra 的訂閱門檻說成同時適用於 Gmail 與 Keep；那個門檻只套用在 Workspace 的「文件」，Gmail 與 Keep 是所有 Google AI 訂閱者都能用。

不把「發表文」與「模型卡」寫成整體互相矛盾。發表文自己的影片圖說與內文都把 Extended Thinking 放在 Gemini app，這一點兩份文件並不衝突。第二輪再收緊一次：也不可以寫「『3.8 Live 也在 Gemini App』只有模型卡寫」——發表文的小節標題（Across Google Workspace, Search, and the Gemini app, our Live models deliver…）與第二段內文（They also make speaking with Gemini across the Gemini app…）都把兩款模型合起來寫進 Gemini app，沒有分開點名。可以寫的只有限定版本：「發表文那張可用性清單沒有把 Gemini App 算給 3.8 Live」。真正只有模型卡寫的是「兩款都上 Google Cloud／Vertex AI」（Vertex AI 在兩篇部落格的可讀內文出現 0 次；模型發表文的 HTML 裡只有「Gemini Enterprise」那個連結的 href 帶 vertex-ai 字樣，那是網址不是它點名的通路），而模型卡反過來沒有列發表文寫的 Gemini Enterprise，所以兩份清單互有出入、誰也沒有涵蓋誰，不可寫成「模型卡列的通路更寬」。
不把每分鐘 0.005／0.018 美元寫成按分鐘計費的牌價；開發者文自己註明那是用每百萬 token 價格換算出的估計值。
不寫 Gemini 3.8 Live 比 Extended Thinking 便宜；兩者在 Gemini API 上是同一張價目表。也不要寫「Extended Thinking 通常用掉更多 token」——Google 沒有印這件事，定價頁只寫輸出價格「含思考 token」。
不把 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe 的發布日期算成 2026-09-15；開發者文兩次寫明它是「上個月」推出的。
不寫模型「通過」前沿安全評估；模型卡的評估對象是上一代 Gemini 3.7 Flash，對這兩款新模型是用「不太可能」的推論帶過，不是直接測過。
不在圖解裡畫任何商標、字標、圖示或介面截圖；圖解與 hero 上出現的任何數字都必須是正文寫過的數字。

factcheck.method: 未參與撰稿。四條 sources 於 2026-09-18 以 curl -sL -A "Mokaair-editorial" 全部重抓（請求中沒有任何 email、姓名或個人資料）：模型發表文 HTTP 200 / 429,811 bytes、開發者文 200 / 391,560、模型卡 200 / 148,728、定價頁 200 / 243,411，四條零轉址、body 都是正文。把內容包拆成 96 條主張逐條回原文核對（title、description、18 段正文、summary 4 句、FAQ 6 題的答句、表格 5 列與 caption、圖解 caption 與研究紀錄 diagram 四格、hero_label、callout；hero.alt 依規格不查不改），並用程式對 28 條 verbatim_quote 做連續字串比對（正規化引號與連字號後全數命中）。沒有使用 sources[] 以外的網址替文章補任何事實。

second_round.checked_by: independent second-round factcheck agent (did not write the draft, did not run the first round)
second_round.method: 四條 sources 當天再抓一次（curl -sL -A "Mokaair-editorial"，請求裡沒有任何 email、姓名或個人資料）：模型發表文 200 / 429,811、開發者文 200 / 391,560、模型卡 200 / 148,728、定價頁 200 / 243,407，零轉址、body 都是正文。三份 HTML 與第一輪抓到的檔案逐位元組相同（cmp），定價頁抽出的純文字也相同，所以第一輪引用的每一句今天都還在頁面上。覆核範圍：第一輪改動過的 29 處與新寫進去的每一句，逐句回四份原文；30 條 verbatim_quote 以正規化（NFKC、彎引號、各種連字號、空白）後的連續字串比對，30/30 命中（第 30 條是 href 裡的 slug，事實本身就寫明是對 HTML 做的 grep）；地區與通路用詞界掃描重跑一次，並把第一輪沒掃的定價頁補掃。
findings: FAQ 第 3 題的「『3.8 Live 也在 Gemini App』與『兩款都上 Vertex AI』這兩項只有模型卡寫」是錯的否定句：發表文的小節標題（Across Google Workspace, Search, and the Gemini app, our Live models deliver…）與第二段內文（They also make speaking with Gemini across the Gemini app…）都把兩款模型合起來寫進 Gemini app，沒有分開點名。FAQ 已改寫成限定版本（發表文那張清單沒把 Gemini App 算給 3.8 Live），第 2 節第 2 段也補了一句「內文與小節標題也把兩款模型合稱寫進去」，讓 FAQ 的說法有正文可依（FAQ 答案 ⊆ 正文）。must_not_write 第 6 條與 verified_facts 第 9 條同步改。
第 2 節第 3 段的「模型卡列的通路更寬」不成立：模型卡的 Distribution 沒有 Gemini Enterprise，而發表文那張清單有，誰也沒有涵蓋誰。已改成「模型卡的通路清單不同」。Gemini Enterprise 這個反向缺口刻意沒有寫進正文（字數已滿，而『不同』這個說法本身就不再主張涵蓋關係），只記在這份紀錄與 must_not_write 第 6 條裡。

callout 的「Google 在本文查核的四份文件裡都沒有寫出開放地區」範圍過寬：第一輪只掃了三份，定價頁其實印著 'Google AI Studio usage is free of charge in all available regions.' 並有一個 'Available regions' 導覽連結。詞界掃描確認四份都沒有點名任何國家、地區或市場，已把 callout 改成「說明可用性時都沒有寫出開放的國家、地區或市場」並把定價頁那句寫進括號裡。
summary 第 2 句「開發者即日起可以…使用兩款模型」比正文強：正文與 Google 寫的都是「即日起開始推出」，而第 3 節整節在講開始不等於完成。已改成照 Google 的措辭。
第 4 節第 3 段與 FAQ 第 5 題把 grounding 的 5,000 次額度接在免費層級那一句後面：定價頁上這個額度與 14 美元印在付費層級那一欄，免費層級那一欄只寫 'Supported'。兩處都補上層級。
圖解：標題與兩格照 left_for_the_owner 第 3 條改（見該條）。
為了把上面兩處但書塞進 3,000 字上限，只刪重複敘述、沒有刪任何限定詞：第 3 節第 1 段結尾的「也就是說，官方未說明開放地區」是同一段前一句的覆述（前一句已寫「沒有一句寫出開放的國家、地區或市場」），改成「本文因此無法判斷…」；第 3 節第 2 段的「使用者無法從官方文件判斷」縮成「使用者無從判斷」。zh-TW 段落 2,984 → 2,992。
rechecked_and_correct: 四個評測數字的主詞全部是 Extended Thinking：原句 'Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking … capturing the #1 overall spot on Artificial Analysis' Speech to Speech Quality Index (82.6), and leads in agentic task completion with 68.6% on τ-Voice and 35.1% on Sierra's τ-Voice-banking benchmark. It also provides strong reasoning capabilities, scoring 97.7% on Big Bench Audio…'；'second place in the Speech Agent Arena' 才是 3.8 Live。指數歸 Artificial Analysis、banking 基準歸 Sierra，文章都寫對了。這五個數字與名次只出現在第 5 節第 1 段一處，表格、摘要、FAQ、圖解都沒有，不可能不一致。τ 在 HTML 裡是 τ-Voice 與 τ-Voice-banking，文章照原樣；tau-cubed 不在這四份來源上。

地區：region / regions / country / countries / market / markets / worldwide / globally / United States / Taiwan 在三份 Google 頁面的詞界掃描全部 0 次；'global' 的命中是版面字樣與開發者文的 'Reach global audiences'。定價頁補掃：country / countries / market / worldwide / globally / global / United States / Taiwan 皆 0，只有 'regions' 兩次（導覽連結 'Available regions'、'free of charge in all available regions'）。全文沒有一句讓讀者以為台灣帳號或繁體中文介面已經支援；『台灣』三次都在『無法判斷／無法代替 Google 確認』的句子裡，『繁體中文』與『中文』在內容包裡 0 次。

方案門檻與狀態詞：'Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in Workspace in Docs, and all Google AI subscribers in Gmail and Keep' 在正文、表格與 FAQ 第 2 題三處都沒有被合併；'rolling out starting today' 在正文引號、表格四列與圖解開發者格一致寫成即日起（開始）推出，不是『開放』；private preview 與兩處 coming soon（Customer Experience 兩款都有、Workspace 企業用戶端只有 Extended Thinking）在正文與表格一致，都寫明沒有時間表。

模型發表文今天（2026-09-18）讀到的更新標記仍是正文第一段的斜體 'Updated September 17, 2026'，署名仍是 'Sep 15, 2026'，兩個 published_time 仍是 2026-09-15；整份 HTML 與 2026-09-18 第一輪抓到的版本逐位元組相同，兩份可用性清單、三段圖說、小節標題、四個評測數字都沒有再被改過。文章第 2 節第 3 段寫的『發表文頂端另標示曾於 9 月 17 日更新』因此不需要改。定價頁頁尾今天仍是 'Last updated 2026-09-16 UTC.'。

價格逐格再對一次：3.8 Live 區塊的付費層級 $0.75 (text) / $3.00 or $0.005/min (audio) / $1.00 or $0.002/min (image/video)、輸出（including thinking tokens）$4.50 (text) / $12.00 or $0.018/min (audio)，免費層級輸入輸出都是 Free of charge，Used to improve our products 的 Yes/No 分野，grounding 的 5,000 次與 $14/1,000 與 'may result in one or more queries' 的 may。這個區塊沒有其他區塊那種『到 2026-12-31 前 X、2027-01-01 起 Y』的分期價，文章寫成單一組價格是對的。

界線：沒有購買、升級或投資建議（『建議』兩次都在『不構成使用或購買建議』），沒有推薦式比價，沒有『值得買／划算／便宜』，沒有本站實測的暗示（『不是實測結果』『本站未自行測試』），能力與名次都歸因給 Google；不帶 finance 主題、只有一個一般 callout、沒有投資免責段落；沒有提到 3.5 Transcribe、3.8 Flash 或站上既有 Gemini 文章的內容，不重寫也不矛盾。

但書沒有被字數擠掉：'up to 128K' 的上限只寫在情境窗那一側、輸出 64K 沒有寫成上限，'Key capabilities include' 沒有寫成全清單，每分鐘價格仍標示為開發者文註腳的換算估計值，前沿安全仍寫成『從 3.7 Flash 的結果推論』而不是『通過』，3.1 Flash Live Preview 仍只寫『較早的』且註明定價頁沒有寫取代或停用。第二輪的改動全部是把話說窄或補上出處，沒有刪任何一個限定詞；zh-TW 段落字數 2,984 → 2,992（上限 3,000）。
